text:
janet: Quick heads-up: we need a single artifact that ties the long-term routing segmentation proposal to launch criteria and sales pricing. Trying to avoid the usual "multiple docs scattered across drives" problem.

kai: Sounds good. I propose we capture: tier definitions, operational contracts, migration windows, telemetry requirements, and an example policy snippet. Keep it short.

prashant: For engineering clarity: each tier should specify p50/p95/p99 latency targets, kv-cache semantics (local/global/none), whether cross-region egress is allowed, and a fallback model path with quantization constraints. Also call out cost-multiplier estimates.

liz: From customer conversations: most mid-market buyers ask for two knobs: (1) Residency/isolated tenancy and (2) Predictable tail latency. They accept throughput limits for stronger isolation if we state the tradeoffs.

janet: Draft launch checklist idea: 1) policy DSL example + validation tests, 2) per-tenant cost estimate script, 3) migration playbook (canary + automated soft-evict), 4) telemetry dashboard widgets + alert thresholds, 5) legal/residency sign-off for data lanes.

sales-bot: note: sales playbook request received from @marco: need UI toggle text and a short paragraph explaining SLA & pricing tiers for demos.

kai: Operational nuance: allowing cross-region KV peeking for the "region-isolate" tier reduces cold-starts but raises egress and increases p99 risk when links are slow. If we permit peeking, we should document expected p99 delta and a configurable peeking window.

prashant: Migration constraints: require an opt-in trial pool (5-10 tenants) and a mandatory smoke/chaos test including slow-link & long-tail-generation. Rollback must be able to route to a compatible regional model variant within 15 minutes.

liz: UI idea: single toggle with tooltip: "Strong Isolation (dedicated compute & residency) — adds X% to base price, slower ramp)". Sales needs explicit multiplier numbers per tier.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout event: policy-seed-v2 deployed to canary cluster (id: canary-98). Logs: https://ci.redwood/dev/rollouts/seed-v2-98

janet: To make this ship-ready: I'll produce a one-pager with: - definition table for tiers - the launch checklist above - a minimal policy DSL example - cost multipliers for finance/sales. Will target EOD Monday.

kai: Example DSL we can include (keep compact):
``` 
policy: tier: "tenant-island"; affinity: "hard"; kv: "none"; fallback: "local-compat"; sla: { p99_ms: 100 }
```

prashant: Add a note: "tenant-island mandates Reserved Capacity contract before cutover". We should also require a tenant-side migration window (2-4 weeks preferred) to allow traffic shaping.

liz: Also include a short customer-facing paragraph for the docs: "If you select Strong Isolation, we provision dedicated resources and guarantee data residency. Typical cost uplift: +30-120% depending on throughput and model family."

janet: Action items: janet -> one-pager + policy snippet; prashant -> migration playbook template + chaos test checklist; kai -> cost delta modeling for peeking vs strict-local cache; liz -> sales/demo copy + pricing multipliers. Reconvene Tue 10am.

janet: anyone opposed to keeping the DSL intentionally tiny for v1? smaller surface = fewer surprises.

kai: no objections. small DSL + clear defaults is the right approach.

janet: Great. I'll post the draft and tag engineering/product for review. Thanks.
